This is a reasonable assessment given the image description. The two testable checkpoints (stocky compact body and dense short fur) were correctly marked as present, aligning with the visible features of the hamster. The Router was not too lenient; the untestable verdicts are justified by the hamster's posture.

The perceptual_quality_auditor confirmed slight blur (severity 0.2), which is consistent with the Router's observation but at a lower severity. The animal_pose_auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk level due to 76% of keypoints having low confidence, indicating widespread structural uncertainty. This suggests more severe artifacts than the Router initially noted, particularly in the limbs and face regions. The Router may have underestimated the severity of structural artifacts, especially given the pose auditor's findings.

The alignment score is adjusted slightly upward from the base due to the strong classifier confirmation.
